GET TO KNOW ME

I understand the excitement of turning an idea into something real.

Hi! It’s Okenwa Chibuzor here, a book designer who loves helping authors bring their ideas to life. My love for reading introduced me to book design, and I became fascinated by the details that make a book feel complete.

When we work together, your ideas matter. My goal is to help turn them into a publication you’re proud to share.

HOW I GOT INTO DESIGN

It started with a desire to create something different.

My journey into graphic design began with a simple desire to become more creative and learn a skill I could use to create meaningful things.

I've always loved reading, so I was soon drawn to book design. I started practising book covers and discovered how much I enjoyed bringing words and visuals together. My interest then grew to interiors, journals, and planners.

I'm still learning and growing as a designer, but one thing hasn't changed: I love helping someone take an idea they've imagined and turn it into something real.

I know your book means more to you than just a finished file.

It's your ideas, your creativity, and the time you've spent making something meaningful. That's why I take the time to understand your vision and pay attention to the details that matter to you.

Good design isn't just about looking beautiful.

A good book design should make the content feel at home. The cover should capture the book's personality, while the interior should make reading easy and enjoyable.

The design process should also feel collaborative. Your ideas and preferences matter.

Your ideas are in thoughtful hands.

I'm a professional book designer with a focus on book covers, journals, and non-fiction book formatting.

WHAT I FOCUS ON:

  • Book cover design
  • Journal and workbook design
  • Non-fiction interior layout and formatting
  • Typography, colour, and layout

A little more about the person behind the designs.

Outside of design, I enjoy reading, exploring creativity, and learning new things. That curiosity is something I bring into every project.
